UPDATE kpi_assignment h SET h.status = ( SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(d.status = 'DANG_SOAN') > 0 OR COUNT(d.id) = 0 THEN 'DANG_SOAN' WHEN SUM(d.status = 'DA_DIEU_CHINH') > 0 THEN 'DA_DIEU_CHINH' ELSE 'DA_GIAO' END FROM kpi_assignment_detail d WHERE d.assignment_id = h.id AND d.deleted = 0) WHERE h.id = #{id}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kpi_assignment_detail (assignment_id, kpi_id, org_unit_id, year, weight, target_q1, target_q2, target_h1, target_q3, target_q4, target_year, status, note, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{assignmentId}, #{kpiId}, #{orgUnitId}, #{year}, #{weight}, #{targetQ1}, #{targetQ2}, #{targetH1}, #{targetQ3}, #{targetQ4}, #{targetYear}, 'DANG_SOAN', #{note}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE kpi_assignment_detail SET weight = #{weight}, target_q1 = #{targetQ1}, target_q2 = #{targetQ2}, target_h1 = #{targetH1}, target_q3 = #{targetQ3}, target_q4 = #{targetQ4}, target_year = #{targetYear}, note = #{note}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DANG_SOAN' AND deleted = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM kpi_assignment_detail WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DANG_SOAN'

mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT assignment_id FROM kpi_assignment_detail WHERE id IN #{i}
mapper.sql: SELECT d.kpi_id, k.code AS kpi_code, k.name AS kpi_name, k.parent_id AS parent_kpi_id, pe.name AS perspective_name, pe.color AS perspective_color, uom.name AS unit_of_measure_name, au.name AS assigning_unit_name, d.year, COUNT(*) AS unit_count, SUM(d.status = 'DANG_SOAN') AS draft_count, SUM(d.status = 'DA_GIAO') AS assigned_count, SUM(d.status = 'DA_DIEU_CHINH') AS adjusted_count, MAX(d.updated_at) AS updated_at, CASE WHEN SUM(d.status = 'DANG_SOAN') > 0 THEN 'DANG_SOAN' WHEN SUM(d.status = 'DA_DIEU_CHINH') > 0 THEN 'DA_DIEU_CHINH' ELSE 'DA_GIAO' END AS status FROM kpi_assignment_detail d JOIN kpi k ON k.id = d.kpi_id JOIN perspective pe ON pe.id = k.perspective_id JOIN unit_of_measure uom ON uom.id = k.unit_of_measure_id JOIN org_unit au ON au.id = k.assigning_unit_id
mapper.select: ORDER BY ${q.orderBy} LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}

mapper.update: UPDATE kpi_assignment_adjustment SET decision_no = #{decisionNo}, decision_date = #{decisionDate}, reason = #{reason}, status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kpi_assignment_adjustment_line (adjustment_id, detail_id, period_code, old_value, new_value, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{adjustmentId}, #{detailId}, #{periodCode}, #{oldValue}, #{newValue}, 'system', 'system')
mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS adjustment_id, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.updated_at, a.id) AS lan, a.decision_no, a.decision_date, a.reason, l.period_code, l.old_value, l.new_value, a.updated_by AS `by`, a.updated_at AS at FROM kpi_assignment_adjustment_line l JOIN kpi_assignment_adjustment a ON a.id = l.adjustment_id AND a.status = 'DA_CHOT' WHERE l.detail_id = #{detailId} ORDER BY a.updated_at, a.id, FIELD(l.period_code, 'Q1','Q2','H1','Q3','Q4')
